articles.title: An umpire told a Cardinals rookie pitcher to fix his hat. Moments later, manager Oli Marmol was ejected
articles.description: "We have a kid making his debut, and in between an at-bat, (umpire Doug Eddings) tells him that he needs to fix his hat," Marmol said.
